name: imaginethis-site
description: Concept-site factory. Rapid prototyping with Astro and Tailwind CSS.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist
scripts.kill-locks:win: cmd /c "for %p in (node.exe esbuild.exe vite.exe astro.exe) do taskkill /F /IM %p 2>nul"
scripts.clean-install:win: npm run kill-locks:win && npm run clean-install
